addr: Church St, opposite Amoeba, Haridevpur, Shanthala Nagar, Ashok Nagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560001, India

rev.t: Definitely lots of books.. the smell of the books reminds me of libraries I used to visit as a kid. …

The collection is wonderful. The store doesn't only keep bestsellers. It keeps many unknown and not well known titles across all genres. Like in old days, people can browse and sample a book before buying it. Recommended for bibliophiles!!!

As a bookworm, this place is a dream. This is first time I've bought physical books in years and I swear I would love to just spend the whole day here discovering new books. Not to mention we found some very cute mushroom cards there! …
